label: contribution_pending
title: Traces
body: A session is waiting for a decision.

label: contribution_preview_busy
title: Preparing preview
body: Privacy processing and pin persistence are in flight.

label: contribution_preview
title: Review trace
body: The reviewed envelope has its own immutable byte identity.

label: contribution_approved
title: Approved
body: The decision is durable; a manual approval has an undo hold.

label: contribution_uploading
title: Uploading
body: The uploader claimed this entry; Undo is no longer accepted.

label: contribution_held
title: Review needed
body: Witness risk or Scrub check returned this session to a person.

label: contribution_offline
title: Waiting to retry
body: Network failure retained the approval and scheduled another attempt.

label: contribution_failed
title: Could not upload
body: The retry budget was spent or the failure was permanent.

label: contribution_kept
title: Kept on this Mac
body: This session was kept locally; Undo offers it again for a person.

label: contribution_expired
title: Expired
body: The unanswered offer aged out while healthy.

label: contribution_superseded
title: Session changed
body: The old offer was superseded; a replacement is a distinct queue entry.

label: contribution_uploaded
title: Sent
body: The queue records delivery; proof receipt status and server processing remain separate.

label: contribution_policy
title: Sharing settings
body: Folder Ask/Automatic/Never is separate from the account-wide Never override. A manual approval survives a later folder Never; the global override holds every send.

label: contribution_history
title: History
body: Local receipts are joined with current-account server read-back.
